project_type: TensorFlow 2.10 research code (groupwise 3D brain MRI registration), Python scripts + SLURM bash launchers; no package build
build_system: none (plain modules run from the repo root). Python 3.8 syntax enforced by tests/run_tests_wsl.sh stage 1 (py_compile + ast feature_version=(3,8)) in conda env bgr_preproc38; no 3.9+ syntax or stdlib
test_framework: unittest. Every TF test module imports tests.tf_setup first. TF-free tests (tests.test_memory_model, test_width_presets, test_slurm_scripts, test_step_times, test_sweep_tools, test_collect_memory_runs, test_predict_store, test_predict_levels, test_compare_tta) run in bgr_preproc38 and must not import tensorflow
test_command: targeted (WSL): wsl -d Ubuntu bash -lc "cd /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/.worktrees/ablation-prereqs && source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate tf_gpu && export TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=3 TF_CUDNN_WORKSPACE_LIMIT_IN_MB=512 BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000 TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0 && python -m unittest <module> -v" (TF-free modules: conda activate bgr_preproc38 instead). Full suite (~7 h, run in background, log to a file): wsl -d Ubuntu bash /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/.worktrees/ablation-prereqs/tests/run_tests_wsl.sh
verification_instructions: 1) Targeted modules of the FEAT pass. 2) Goldens 0 diff: tests.test_trainer (TestLinearGolden m7_linear_golden.json and the LNCC deform golden lncc_deform_golden.json; stderr '[golden] max |diff| 0') and tests.test_predict_tta_golden ('[golden tta-off] N hashes compared, 0 differ'). Never rewrite fixtures (BGR_WRITE_GOLDEN must stay unset). 3) Final: full run_tests_wsl.sh, 'suite status: 0'.
snapshot_or_generated_files: tests/fixtures/*.json golden fixtures are checked in and must NOT change. No generated files.
environment_constraints: Local GPU is an 8 GB GTX 1080 under WSL (6000 MB TF limit): use TINY / NARROW configs (tests/runtime_helpers.py tiny_config / narrow_config; level 1 on small widths like tests/test_predict_streaming.py TINY_L1 = filters (4,16,16,16,16,16), decoder_widths (8,8,8,4,4)). tf_gpu env crashes CPU-only (leave CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES alone). DALI not available locally (DALI tests skip). Do NOT submit cluster jobs or ssh. TF32 must stay off (models.precision.configure_tf_precision). Work only in the worktree; relative paths land in the parent workspace.
contribution_requirements: Defaults bit-identical (configs A/B, norm batch: goldens 0 diff). No unrequested refactors. Follow existing conventions (docstrings with design references, ValueError/parser.error messages naming flags). Stage files by name; never commit other agents' untracked folders (.agents/tasks/final-comparison/, .agents/tasks/smoothness-scaling/) or raw _*.log. Commit locally on branch ablation-prereqs, never push (merge step does it).
key_patterns: ModelConfig (models/config.py) is a TF-free dataclass serialized to config.json; cascade/warm start compare all fields but seed (runtime/checkpoint.check_cascade_config, models/cascade.FrozenChain). Group blocks = layers.GroupConvBlock/GroupDenseBlock with group=True (concat of group mean after norm-act). Streaming inference (inference/streaming.StreamedLevel) runs blocks chunkwise and accumulates float32 group sums only for grouped blocks (_apply_block branches on block.group). SLURM level scripts validate env with need_uint/need_float/need_choice, assemble MAIN/CHECK arrays, and with BGR_DRY_RUN=1 print 'MAIN: python main.py ...' / 'CHECK: ...' and exit before side effects; tests/test_slurm_scripts.py runs them dry and parses MAIN with runtime.args.parse_args. r_cascade.sh chains r_level4/2/1.sh with per-level env (level_env), unsets LEVEL_ENV_KEYS, records recipe in a chain state JSON and refuses recipe mismatches on resume.
directory_structure: models/ (network, config, layers, cascade, memory model), runtime/ (args, Trainer run.py, checkpoint, losses, metrics), inference/ (predict loader, streaming engine, runner, TTA, recenter), data_loading/ (DALI + TF postprocess), slurm/ (cluster launchers), tests/ (unittest; tests/gpu/ cluster-only checks incl. check_mixed_run.py), .agents/tasks/<task>/ (task docs)
